run_load_paired_dataset: run the load_paired_dataset function to load paired chat and program data from files
create_Tree2TextDataset: create a Tree2TextDataset PyTorch dataset from paired program and chat data lists
run_collate: run the collate function to pad and tensorize tree and text batches with tokenizers
run_main_cli: run the main CLI to load a dataset partition and print random samples
review_Tree2TextDataset_getitem: review the Tree2TextDataset __getitem__ method that returns paired program and chat samples by index
